headline: James Webb Space Telescope Identifies Atmospheric Carbon Dioxide on Distant Exoplanet
description: Astronomers using NASA's James Webb Space Telescope have detected unambiguous molecular evidence of carbon dioxide in the atmosphere of a gas giant exoplanet orbiting a sun-like star 700 light-years away, marking a crucial step in the characterization of exoplanet atmospheres.

headline: Global Renewable Energy Capacity Reaches Historic Milestone Driven by Solar Expansion
description: According to the latest annual capacity statistics published by the International Renewable Energy Agency, global renewable electricity generation capacity reached unprecedented levels, with solar photovoltaics accounting for nearly three-quarters of new additions worldwide.

headline: International Consortium Unveils Open Comprehensive Human Pangenome Reference
description: The Human Pangenome Reference Consortium has published an expanded genomic collection reflecting greater ancestral diversity, significantly improving alignment accuracy and the detection of complex structural genetic variations across populations.

headline: Breakthrough in Room-Pressure Quantum Coherence Demonstrated in Solid-State Systems
description: Physicists have sustained long-lived quantum coherence at ambient room conditions using optically addressable spin defects in hexagonal boron nitride, paving the way for scalable quantum sensors operating without cryogenic refrigeration.

headline: European Space Agency Euclid Mission Transmits First Full-Colour Wide-Field Deep Space Views
description: The European Space Agency's Euclid space telescope has released its inaugural high-resolution wide-angle cosmological survey images, revealing millions of galaxies across cosmic time to map dark matter and cosmic expansion.
